UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Aqua PC Parts customer profile synchronized via Google, Facebook, or Email/Password.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Customer display name shown in the header and Customer Portal.

email.description: Customer email address (PII, restricted to owner).

phone.description: Optional WhatsApp or contact phone number for fast-tracking orders.

city.description: Optional Sri Lanka delivery city or town.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

SavedQuote.title: SavedQuote
SavedQuote.description: Customer-saved PC hardware quote snapshot stored for cross-device access.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this saved quote.

title.description: Human-readable quote title (e.g., Gaming PC Build Quote).

itemCount.description: Total number of items in the quote (1 to 100).

summary.description: Formatted line-by-line hardware and SKU summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quote was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quote was last modified.

InventoryOverride.title: InventoryOverride
InventoryOverride.description: Live storefront price and workshop stock count override keyed by product SKU (public read, admin-only write).

sku.description: Unique product inventory SKU matching the document ID.

price.description: Optional live LKR price override (0 to 100,000,000).

inStock.description: Whether the product is currently available for order.

lowStockThreshold.description: Threshold at or below which a low-stock indicator is shown (1 to 50).

note.description: Optional short workshop stock note (e.g., Last unit tested).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest stock update.

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who performed the stock update.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Tracked Aqua PC Parts hardware order or workshop build request with live fulfillment stages.

orderId.description: Order document ID matching the document path.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated customer who placed the order.

customerName.description: Customer name printed on the workshop invoice.

customerEmail.description: Customer email for order tracking and invoice copy.

deliveryCity.description: Optional Sri Lanka delivery city or workshop pickup note.

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment option selected by the customer.

itemsSummary.description: Line-by-line hardware list with SKUs, quantities, and LKR totals.

itemCount.description: Total item count in the order (1 to 100).

statusNote.description: Optional technician bench-test or courier tracking note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was last updated.

OrderTracking.title: OrderTracking
OrderTracking.description: Public zero-PII live fulfillment tracking projection keyed by orderNumber for Track Order lookups.

orderNumber.description: Human-friendly order reference number matching the document ID (e.g., AQ-261125-4K9M).

orderId.description: Parent private order document ID in /orders/{orderId}.

ownerId.description: UID of the customer who placed the order.

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment option selected for the order.

deliveryRegion.description: Optional non-PII delivery city or workshop pickup label.

itemCount.description: Total item count in the order (1 to 100).

statusNote.description: Optional technician bench-test or courier tracking note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest status update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private customer profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/savedQuotes/{quoteId}.description: Customer-owned saved hardware quotes and cart snapshots.

/inventoryOverrides/{sku}.description: Live storefront price and workshop stock overrides keyed by SKU.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Tracked customer hardware orders and workshop build requests (private PII).

/orderTracking/{orderNumber}.description: Zero-PII public live order status tracking documents keyed by orderNumber.
